title: Apartment Home Lease Payment Plan Rule
content:
A payment plan lets an Apartment Home Lease resident clear past-due amounts through a down payment and equal installments. The resident-facing terms are set out below; withdrawn clauses are marked as no longer in force.

## Terms in force

**1. Availability.** A payment plan is available only on an active or in-default lease that has not been referred to eviction counsel.

**2. Size.** The arrears a plan covers may not exceed the floor plan's maximum arrears multiple times the monthly rent.

**3. Installments.** The rest of the arrears after the down payment is split into at most the floor plan's maximum installments, in equal installments rounded to the cent with the last installment absorbing the difference; each installment after the first falls due the floor plan's installment interval in calendar days after the previous one.

**4. Refusal.** A plan is refused when the number of payment plans on the lease that are signed, completed or defaulted and were created within the trailing 365 days (ending on and including the evaluation date) already equals the floor plan's plans per trailing 365 days, or when any plan on the lease defaulted within the trailing 365 days.

**5. Signature.** A payment plan takes effect only when the resident's signature is recorded on the plan request; an agent's promise or a resident's verbal agreement never activates a plan. The signature is read from the plan request record. Signing is the resident's own act.

**6. Plan payments.** Payments of a plan carry its plan reference.

**7. Good standing and default.** A plan stays in good standing while every installment is paid by its due date plus the floor plan's missed-installment grace days. After that the plan is defaulted, the unpaid remainder is simply past due, and the covered periods again count as late from the default date.

**8. Completion.** When the last installment is paid the plan is completed.

**9. Rent during the plan.** Rent that falls due during the plan is not covered by it and must be paid on time.

## Applying the terms (hypothetical)

- *Installment rounding.* $1,000.00 split into 3 equal installments: $333.33, $333.33 and a last installment of $333.34.
- *Grace on an installment.* An installment due 15 June with 3 grace days keeps the plan in good standing if paid on 18 June; if it is still unpaid at the end of 18 June, the plan is defaulted.
- *Allowance used.* On a floor plan allowing 1 plan per trailing 365 days, a plan signed eight months ago and completed since still counts, and a new plan is refused.
- *Verbal agreement.* A resident who agrees by phone to a plan has no plan until the signature is recorded on the request.

## Clauses no longer in force

- The clause under which a payment plan covers the whole balance due of the lease on the day the plan is drawn up is no longer in force.
- The clause placing the first installment the installment interval in calendar days after the day the plan is drawn up is no longer in force.
- The clause setting the down payment at least at the floor plan's minimum down payment share of the arrears, rounded up to the cent, is no longer in force.

These clauses are reproduced so an older plan record can be read, not to be applied.

superseded_clauses: A payment plan covers the whole balance_due of the lease on the day it is drawn up (arrears_amount)
the first due payment_plan_installment_interval_days calendar days after the plan is drawn up
The down payment is at least payment_plan_min_down_pct of the arrears, rounded up to the cent
